GERMAN (`de`): cardinals are written German compounds, lowercase (`null`, `eins` standalone, `einundzwanzig`, `einhunderteins`, `eintausenddreihundertneunundsechzig`, `eine Million`, `zwei Millionen fünfhunderttausend`), decimal digits read one by one (`drei Komma eins vier`); issue numbers keep the English shape (`zwölf zweiundvierzig`, `zwölfhundert`, `zwölf null fünf`, `zweitausend`, 5+ digits digit by digit); spelling stays letter by letter and the Markdown rules are the same in every language; whitespace collapses; the result stops at the last sentence end within `maxChars` (else at a word boundary + `copy.ellipsis`).
